_contract.rotation: yaw k*90 deg about +Y; r0 front faces +z (screen left-down), r1 faces +x (screen right-down); rot_map[k] = [baked rotation index, flip_h]
_contract.pivot: ground point at the footprint centre (wall items: on the wall plane below the item centre)
_contract.float: floating bits of the LEGENDARY pieces only (the 11 legendary ids carry one per baked rotation; unique pieces have none: their cue is shape and palette): same crop + pivot as the main sprite, bobbed by the engine (bob_px / bob_seconds)
_contract.glow: additive tint of iso_props/fx/glow_soft.webp at `center` (px in the sprite), scaled to radius_px
_contract.mirror_ok: true = this piece MAY be drawn as flip_h of the other rotation (disk fallback, measured by measure_mirror.py); the true files exist anyway unless exported with --mirror-fallback
_contract.icon: relative path of the 128x128 icon (and <id>_night.webp for legendary pieces)
